verdict.rationale: Publishing current processing times is a fair question for a government transaction portal like ANEF, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has nothing showing that ANEF publishes processing times for any transaction type. The probes only show that the portal serves a ~3 KB JavaScript shell to keyless agents, with every transaction behind an account, and that the parent ministry site returns a Cloudflare challenge. That shell may hide content, which is why confidence is low.
